title: Warehouse Barcode Scanner Terminal Soft Reset & Staging Recovery

purpose.text: Automated workflow to verify ADB connectivity, clear application cache, apply staging profile, verify configuration, and reboot Zebra TC52 scanners.
purpose.quote: Automated workflow to verify ADB connectivity, clear application cache, apply staging profile, verif

scope.text: Applies to hardware operations and authorized agents.
scope.quote: Applies to hardware operations and authorized agents.

roles.responsibility: Executes Warehouse Barcode Scanner Terminal Soft Reset & Staging Recovery

steps.action: Verify ADB connectivity and device state before executing recovery commands.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'device', set variables.device_online = true, else set variables.device_online = false
steps.quote: Verify ADB connectivity and device state before executing recovery commands.

steps.action: Purge memory cache for the warehouse fulfillment scan application.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Success', set variables.cache_cleared = true, else set variables.cache_cleared = false
steps.quote: Purge memory cache for the warehouse fulfillment scan application.

steps.action: Broadcast StageNow automated staging intent profile to apply configuration.
steps.input: adb shell am broadcast -a com.symbol.stagenow.action.EXECUTE -e script_file "{{entities.staging_script_path}}"
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Broadcast completed', set variables.profile_broadcast = true, else set variables.profile_broadcast = false
steps.quote: Broadcast StageNow automated staging intent profile to apply configuration.

steps.action: Query device diagnostic logcat to confirm successful profile application.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout is not empty, set variables.profile_applied = true, else set variables.profile_applied = false
steps.quote: Query device diagnostic logcat to confirm successful profile application.

steps.action: Soft reboot the mobile computer scanner to apply persistent runtime settings.
steps.quote: Soft reboot the mobile computer scanner to apply persistent runtime settings.
